verdict.summary: Round 7 resolves the prior major resource-exhaustion finding. The filtered auxiliary-arm paging loop now caps its own escalation at MAX_ARM_PAGE (65,536), fails closed with an arm-named error when the admissible ranking cannot be established within that bound, and preserves a caller's explicitly requested candidates page without geometrically escalating beyond the documented cap. The new end-to-end test uses a non-exhausting arm with distinct valid inline IDs, proves that the real query path reaches but never exceeds the cap, and verifies fail-closed behavior. The earlier inline-ID correctness witness remains present, so the safety fix does not restore the round-5 premature dictionary-length cutoff. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or hostile-instruction issue is evident in the supplied diff.
